title: Finish reviewed renames already committed in task worktrees
requirements: Repair Pipeline.finish after the same scope-validated snapshot so it can merge both uncommitted and already committed allowed-path renames. It must not call git add with a deleted pathspec, must retain the existing validation/review/base/current-snapshot checks, and must not stage an out-of-scope change.

Extend the pipeline regression coverage to commit a task-worktree rename before validation, then prove validation, review and finish merge it successfully. Preserve the existing uncommitted rename regression from PIPE-009 and all controller safeguards.
Do not change product code, task-state recovery data, environment handling, integrations or documentation.
acceptance: A reviewed rename completes regardless of whether the executor committed it before validation, while the scope gate remains authoritative.
The full pipeline test suite and whitespace check pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: The first rename repair covered a working-tree rename but not an executor-committed rename, which still blocks an otherwise reviewed task from finishing.
